events.title: Robowars
events.subtitle: The Ultimate Combat Robotics Arena
events.description: Robowars, a major event at Techniche, showcases top talents in robotics through intense competition. Participants design and develop wireless, manually controlled robots to engage in dual combat within a specified arena. The event highlights innovative strategies, mechanical strength, and strategic maneuvering, creating a thrilling spectacle.

rounds.title: Registration & Verification
rounds.description: After completing registration through Unstop, create an account on Techniche website and register via dashboard.

rules: Robots compete in specified 30kg and 15kg weight categories.
Strategic maneuvering and destructive battle mechanics permitted within arena bounds.

events.title: Aquawars
events.subtitle: Naval Robotics & Aquatic Combat
events.description: Dive into the action-packed world of Aqua Wars, an electrifying game that combines the thrill of robotics with the challenge of aquatic battles. In this multiplayer competitive game, players take control of powerful robotic machines and engage in intense combat within dynamic water arenas. The aim of the competition is to provide a conceptual design of a water surface robot with good speed, manoeuvring capabilities, stability against high velocity and turbulence in the water, can fight with another robot, and has the power to damage it.

rounds.title: Stage 1 (Online): Report Submission
rounds.description: Registered teams must submit an SRE (System Review Evaluation) report following guidelines.

rounds.title: Stage 2 (Offline): Finals
rounds.description: Offline finals conducted on campus at IIT Guwahati during Techniche 26.

events.title: Escalade
events.subtitle: Escalade 15.0 - Flagship National Robotics Competition
events.description: Escalade, the flagship National Robotics Competition organized by the Robotics module of Techniche, is the largest and fastest-growing robotics event in the northeast. In Escalade 15.0, autonomous or remote-controlled robots must climb a vertical pole and accurately launch balls at designated targets.

events.title: Track Titans
events.subtitle: High-Performance RC Car Racing & Endurance
events.description: Track Titans challenges participants to design and build remote-controlled cars with exceptional speed, agility, and endurance while adhering to technical specifications. The primary objective is to achieve the fastest lap times and outmanoeuvring competitors on a challenging race track.

events.title: LineQuest
events.subtitle: Autonomous Line Maze Navigation Challenge
events.description: Line Quest is Techniche IIT Guwahati's flagship autonomous line-following challenge where innovation meets speed, precision, and intelligent decision-making. Design and build an autonomous robot capable of navigating a complex line maze during Dry Run and Actual Run following the shortest path in minimum possible time.

events.title: Avinya
events.subtitle: National School Innovation Contest
events.description: High school students showcase creative tech prototypes, science models, and social innovation projects.

events.title: STPI Tech Pitch
events.subtitle: Software Technology Parks Innovation Challenge
events.description: Early stage startups and student entrepreneurs pitch software and hardware solutions directly to STPI mentors.

events.title: Funniche
events.subtitle: Fun On-Spot Games & Micro Challenges
events.description: Casual mini-games, pop quizzes, laser tag, and interactive fun stalls open to all fest attendees.

events.title: Catalysis T
events.subtitle: Chemical & Bio-Tech Solution Sprint
events.description: Case study sprint addressing sustainable chemical processes, green energy, and biotechnology innovations.

events.title: Full Stack Web Development
events.subtitle: Modern React & Node.js Bootcamp
events.description: Hands-on masterclass covering modern web development, state management, REST APIs, and deployment.

events.title: Generative AI & Agentic AI
events.subtitle: LLM Agents & Prompt Engineering
events.description: Explore building autonomous LLM agents, RAG systems, and generative multimodal applications.

events.title: Arduino Project Development
events.subtitle: Embedded Systems & Sensor Networks
events.description: Build micro-controller projects with sensors, motor drivers, wireless communication modules, and IoT relays.

events.title: Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking
events.subtitle: Network Security & Penetration Testing
events.description: Learn vulnerability assessment, penetration testing techniques, wireless security auditing, and ethical hacking protocols.

events.title: Live Project
events.subtitle: Real-world Corporate Problem Solving
events.description: Collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to tackle real-world industry case studies with mentorship from corporate executives.

events.title: Mentorship
events.subtitle: 1-on-1 Guidance with Domain Experts
events.description: Get personalized feedback on your startup pitch, research thesis, career trajectory, and technical roadmaps from experienced mentors.

events.title: Global Innovation Keynote
events.subtitle: Insights from World Tech Leaders
events.description: Inspirational talks by world-renowned scientists, tech visionaries, and industry pioneers sharing breakthroughs in science & technology.

events.title: Defense Tech & Army Expo
events.subtitle: Advanced Military & Aerospace Displays
events.description: Exhibition showcasing modern defense technology, drone systems, robotics, and aerospace innovations.
